meta.title: Free Invoice Generator | BillEase
meta.description: Create a professional invoice in minutes. Thirteen templates, your own colours and logo, and a PDF you can download or email. Free, no account needed.
meta.ogDescription: Thirteen templates. Fill it in, download the PDF. No account.

landing.intro: BillEase builds a professional invoice in your browser and hands you a PDF. Choose one of thirteen templates, set your accent colour and typeface, add your logo and signature, and download or email the result. Nothing is uploaded to an account, because there are no accounts.
landing.guideIntro: A walk through what the invoice generator does and how to use it: the thirteen templates, the things you can change about them, and the three steps from an empty form to a finished PDF.

1.title: Thirteen templates
1.body: Genuinely different layouts, not one layout in thirteen colours — full-bleed headers, accent rails, centred mastheads, ruled forms and a compact receipt style. Every one is a proper A4 page and paginates correctly when the invoice runs long.

2.title: Make it yours
2.body: Pick an accent colour from the presets or any hex you like, choose between four typefaces, and set the density to fit twenty line items on one page or let three of them breathe. Add a logo and a drawn, typed or uploaded signature.

3.title: A real PDF
3.body: Rendered with the same engine your browser uses, with the fonts embedded, so the file looks the same on every machine that opens it. Download it, print it, or send it straight to your client by email.

1.title: Fill in the details
1.body: Who is invoicing whom, the dates, the line items, and your payment details. Everything you type appears in the preview beside the form as you go, and your work is saved in your browser as a draft.

2.title: Choose how it looks
2.body: Open the template gallery to compare all thirteen layouts side by side with your own data in them, then set the colour, typeface and density.

3.title: Generate the PDF
3.body: One click produces the document. Download it, print it, save it to reopen later, or email it to your client without leaving the page.

1.a: Yes. There is no paid tier, no trial, and no account to create. The invoice generator, all thirteen templates and the PDF export are free to use.

2.q: Do I need to sign up?
2.a: No. Your invoice is held in your own browser while you work on it, and saved invoices stay in your browser's local storage. Nothing is stored on a server.

3.q: Can I add my company logo?
3.a: Yes. Upload an image on the invoice details step and it appears on twelve of the thirteen templates. The Minimal template is deliberately logo-free.

4.q: What currencies and languages are supported?
4.a: Over a hundred and seventy currencies, formatted for the language you are using, and the interface is translated into eighteen languages. The invoice document itself is translated into thirteen of them.

5.q: Can I edit an invoice after generating the PDF?
5.a: Yes. Change any field and the preview returns to live editing straight away, then generate again when you are ready.

trend.title: Invoiced per month ({currency})
trend.none: No invoices in the last 12 months.
trend.flat: Steady: the last 3 months are within 15% of the 3 before.
trend.new: New activity: nothing was invoiced in the 3 months before.
trend.up: Up {percent}% over the last 3 months compared with the 3 before.
trend.down: Down {percent}% over the last 3 months compared with the 3 before.

insights.title: Insights
insights.none: No observations yet: they appear as invoices, payments and quotations build up.
insights.noActivity: Nothing recorded for this customer yet: no invoices or quotations.
insights.overdue: {count, plural, one {# invoice is} other {# invoices are}} overdue: {amount} outstanding, the oldest {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} past due.
insights.paysLate: Usually pays late: on average {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the due date, and only {rate}% of paid invoices were settled on time.
insights.paysOnTime: Reliable payer: {rate}% of paid invoices were settled on time, typically within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of issue.
insights.paysMixed: Mixed payment record: {rate}% of paid invoices were settled by the due date.
insights.dormant: No invoice for {days} days. They usually order about every {usual} days.
insights.frequent: Buys regularly: {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} in the last 12 months, about every {days} days.
insights.acceptedNotInvoiced: {count, plural, one {# accepted quotation has} other {# accepted quotations have}} not been invoiced yet (first: {number}, {amount}).
insights.quotesExpiring: {count, plural, one {# quotation expires} other {# quotations expire}} within 7 days.
insights.trendUp: Invoiced amounts are up {percent}% over the last 3 months compared with the 3 before.
insights.trendDown: Invoiced amounts are down {percent}% over the last 3 months compared with the 3 before.
insights.largeShare: Accounts for {percent}% of your {currency} invoiced revenue.

payment.title: Record a payment from {name}
payment.hint: The payment is split across their open invoices, oldest due date first, or applied to one invoice.
payment.owed: {amount} owed across {count, plural, one {# open invoice} other {# open invoices}}.
payment.recordedBody: {amount} applied to {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}.

errors.nothingOwed: This customer has no open invoices to pay.
errors.exceeds: That is more than is owed ({owed}). Enter at most the amount owed.
errors.notFound: That invoice is no longer open.

statement.badRange: The start date must be on or before the end date.
statement.openItems: Open invoices at the end date
statement.none: No issued invoices yet, so there is no statement to show. Draft and cancelled invoices are not included.
statement.noBusiness: A PDF needs your business details. Issue an invoice to this customer first (or save a sender) and it will be used here.
statement.definitions: Debits are issued invoices; credits are payments received. Drafts and cancelled invoices are excluded. One currency per statement.
statement.pdfFailedBody: Try again, or use the CSV export.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Record what the business spends. Amounts are kept in the currency you enter, and currencies are never added together.
expenses.categoriesHint: Built-in categories are fixed. Add your own, rename them, or delete them once no expense depends on them.
expenses.noCustomCategories: You have not added any categories yet.
expenses.deleteCategoryInUse: {count, plural, one {# expense uses} other {# expenses use}} this category. Choose where to move them first.

categoryToast.reassigned: {count, plural, one {# expense was} other {# expenses were}} moved.

categoryErrors.name: Enter a name of at least 2 characters.
categoryErrors.taken: A category with that name already exists.
categoryErrors.limit: You have reached the limit of custom categories.
categoryErrors.storage: The browser could not save this. Check free space and try again.
categoryErrors.inUse: Move the expenses in this category first.
categoryErrors.badTarget: Choose a different category to move the expenses to.

form.title: Expense title
form.amountHint: The total paid, including any tax.
form.recoverableHint: For example input GST you can claim back. It is then left out of the cost in the profit estimate.

expenses.formHint: Title, category, amount, currency and date are required. Everything else is optional.

errors.title: Enter a title of at least 2 characters.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as USD.
errors.dateFuture: That date is too far in the future.
errors.taxExceeds: Tax cannot be more than the amount.
errors.rate: The rate must be between 0 and 100.
errors.storage: The browser could not save this. Check free space and try again.
errors.limit: You have reached the limit of saved expenses.

expenses.confirmDeleteBody: This removes the expense from your records and from profit and loss figures. It cannot be undone.

empty.title: No expenses yet
empty.body: Record rent, salaries, utilities and other costs to see your profit and where the money goes.

expenses.search: Search title, vendor, reference or notes

period.label: Period
period.badRange: The start date must not be after the end date.

expenses.exportedBody: {count, plural, one {# expense} other {# expenses}} saved to a CSV file.

profit.title: Profit & loss
profit.subtitle: Cash and profit are shown separately on purpose: unpaid invoices are never counted as money received.
profit.pdfFailedBody: Try again, or export the CSV instead.
profit.linkedNote: {count, plural, one {# expense is} other {# expenses are}} linked to a supplier bill and counted once, through the bill.
profit.basisNote: Cash basis counts money that actually moved: payments received less expenses paid. Invoice basis is an estimate: what you billed (excluding tax) less your costs, whether or not customers have paid yet.

cash.title: Cash basis
cash.note: Money received and money spent in the period.

invoice.title: Invoice basis (estimate)
invoice.note: Issued invoices less expenses, paid or not.

profit.cashIn: More came in than went out
profit.cashOut: More went out than came in
profit.invoicedHint: {count, plural, one {# issued invoice} other {# issued invoices}}, tax included
profit.outstandingHint: Still owed by customers at the end date
profit.overdueHint: Part of outstanding that is past its due date

lines.payables: Owed to suppliers at end date

profit.definitions: Revenue is what you invoiced less the tax on those invoices. Cost is expenses less any recoverable tax. Receivables are shown on their own because they are neither cash nor cost.
profit.monthlyInvoiceNote: Revenue from invoices issued each month against that month's cost. An estimate, not money received.
profit.monthlyCashNote: Payments received each month against expenses paid that month.

insights.none: No observations yet: they appear as invoices, payments and expenses build up.
insights.noExpenses: No expenses are recorded for this period, so the estimated profit probably overstates the real result.
insights.lossEstimate: On an invoice basis this period is an estimated loss of {amount}.
insights.profitEstimate: On an invoice basis this period shows an estimated profit of {amount}, a {margin}% margin.
insights.cashNegative: More cash went out than came in: net cash flow is minus {amount}.
insights.cashPositive: More cash came in than went out: net cash flow is {amount}.
insights.profitNotCash: The estimated profit is not in the bank yet: {amount} is still owed by customers.
insights.receivablesHigh: {percent}% of what you invoiced ({amount}) has not been paid yet.
insights.topCategory: {category} is the largest cost: {percent}% of spending ({amount}).
insights.largestExpense: The largest single expense is "{title}" at {amount}.
insights.expensesUp: Spending is up {percent}% on the previous period of the same length.
insights.expensesDown: Spending is down {percent}% on the previous period of the same length.

empty.title: Nothing to report yet
empty.body: Issue invoices and record expenses, and this page will show your cash flow and estimated profit.

snapshot.title: Cash and profit · {year}
snapshot.sub: In {currency}. Cash is money that moved; profit is an estimate from invoices.
snapshot.noExpenses: No expenses recorded this year. Add some to see net cash flow and profit that mean something.

reportDocument.title: Profit & loss
reportDocument.cashBasisNote: Money actually received and spent in the period.
reportDocument.invoiceBasisNote: Invoices issued less expenses, whether or not paid. This is not cash.
reportDocument.receivablesNote: Owed by customers at the end date. Neither cash nor cost.
reportDocument.payablesNote: Owed to suppliers on bills at the end date. Neither cash nor cost.
reportDocument.note: All figures are in a single currency; other currencies are reported separately and never added in. Estimated profit is based on invoices, not on money received.
